entries.title: Ron/gm Based Design Methodology for Dynamic Amplifiers
entries.desc: Novel Ron/gm-based design methodology for inverter-based non-linear dynamic amplifiers. Models RC, large-signal, and small-signal settling stages; validated on an inverter-based switched-capacitor amplifier in IHP SG13G2 using open-source EDA tools (Xschem, NGSpice). Authors: Nithin Purushothama, Pramoda SR, Suyajnaa, Runpeng Gao, Praveen Kumar Venkatachala, Prof. Madhav Pathak.

entries.title: Analog CMOS Multiplier Circuits: Design and Comparative Analysis
entries.desc: Design and comparison of analog multiplier circuits for low-power pre-ADC sensor processing, power management, and analog neural networks using translinear and linear MOSFET-based MAC architectures. Authors: Nithin Purushothama, Prof. Madhav Pathak.
